_about: What each vendor itself calls a plugin, per language: THE table (rule and method: docs/i18n-vendor-terms.md). label = the word as the user sees it in that vendor's sidebar; stem = a lowercase fragment every string of that vendor's key family must contain (so inflected forms still match); evidence = app | help-path | help-title | english-fallback. Change a row only on a vendor rename, a new language or a user report, and update 'checked'.
